scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-file:./dev.db}" npm run install:all && DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-file:./dev.db}" npm run build --prefix client && DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-file:./dev.db}" npm run build --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
